title: Evidence & Reliability

principles.title: Chain of Custody
principles.definition: A documented history of evidence handling from collection to courtroom presentation.
why_it_matters: Authenticity: proves the item is what it is claimed to be

principles.title: Reliability & Weight (Conceptual)
themes: Not all evidence is equal; weight depends on source, context, and corroboration

common_categories.strength: Context-dependent; can be influenced by memory and stress

quality_checks: Corroboration count: how many independent sources support the same point?
Alternative explanations: what else could produce the same observation?

principles.title: Digital Evidence (High-Level)
themes: Metadata is evidence; do not overwrite originals
Keep logs of access and analysis steps

practice_prompts: What would a defense attorney challenge first in this evidence chain?
Which piece of evidence is most independent (least contaminated by other steps)?
Where does uncertainty remain and how is it documented?
